title: Design System: Aurora Haze · Sydia onboarding

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Shared grainy aurora action for advancing setup or starting chat.

components.name: Back action
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}.ds-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--color-ink);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-ink) 16%,transparent)}.ds-outline:hover{color:var(--color-ink)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-brand) 50%,transparent);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-button:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.4;filter:saturate(.5);pointer-events:none}

components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--color-ink);font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-input{height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-ink) 16%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--color-canvas);color:var(--color-ink);font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:15px}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--color-ink-muted)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-brand) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:0;border-color:var(--color-brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-brand) 15%,transparent)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.4}.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--destructive);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--destructive) 15%,transparent)}

narrative.overview:
This scoped guide describes the onboarding components and their completion scene. It inherits the established [Aurora Haze system](../../../../../DESIGN.md), the app's shared primitives, and the approved Penpot layout direction. It does not replace the global design system.

Personalization stays quiet: warm bone-white space, clear graphite headings, restrained coral state cues, and familiar controls. Completion gives that same world a warmer welcome through the selected persona, a soft coral–peach–violet bloom, and sparse celebratory particles.
keyCharacteristics: Calm task surfaces with one clear next action.
Inter throughout, with bold headings and quieter supporting copy.
Personal identity expressed through existing persona artwork.
A celebratory completion that remains readable and accessible.

rules.name: The Readable Welcome Rule
rules.body: Preserve the completion heading's darker rose emphasis. The bright coral used for decorative particles and selection accents is not the headline text treatment; check text against the brightest and darkest parts of the moving bloom.

rules.name: The Scoped Celebration Rule
rules.body: The user-authorized animated coral–peach–violet bloom, persona ring, and deterministic confetti are an exception for this completion scene to the global restraint on gradient placement and motion. Do not propagate this exception to setup steps, settings, or unrelated product surfaces.

dos: **Do** inherit Aurora Haze and existing shared controls before introducing a new visual primitive.
**Do** keep the completion message and action readable over every bloom state.
**Do** preserve keyboard selection, visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, and hidden-document pausing.
**Do** carry the selected persona into the completion scene.
donts: **Don't** extend the completion gradient and motion exception to unrelated surfaces.
**Don't** make channel linking or billing an added barrier to finishing this personalization flow.
**Don't** replace confirmed connection state or chat-start errors with decorative success claims.
**Don't** turn individual particle positions, portrait dimensions, or animation delays into application-wide tokens.
